scenes.narration: No camera and no footage. So how was this film made?
First the story: a hook on the first frame, one thing to follow, and every line approved word for word.
Then an AI voice reads it, and every word gets a time, so the picture lands on the word.
The music is cut on the beat, so its strongest bar hits the payoff.
And before anyone sees it, a blind transcript checks that every line made it in.
That's how: one story, a moving camera, and not a single frame filmed.
Now tell your own story, one line at a time.
